question: On a credential-free substrate class materially different from the mandatory-discovery deterministic REST class - multi-task sessions where one-time session/resource/schema discovery is amortized or cached across tasks - can an asymmetric-discovery task bank be certified ARITHMETICALLY BEFORE FREEZE: B-COLD-RE-DERIVE and B-RETRIEVAL-SHAPED success_rate < 0.95 at novelty >= 0.5 on at least one task family, matched correctness >= 0.80 for all arms, a real treatment/comparator behavioural distinction, honest per-condition counters (http_requests + retrieval_calls + verification_calls + repair_attempts), and a preregistered contamination/dynamic-range certificate - such that the bank is deliverable as a reusable substrate unblocking the flagship inheritance benchmark B2? If the certificate is unsatisfiable on every credential-free substrate tested, the mandated outcome is a bounded substrate-class negative and freeze nothing.
hypothesis: The SESSION-BINDING substrate class (credential-free deterministic stdlib localhost HTTP; K=8-task sessions; one-time 48-bit session-scoped resource binding revealed exactly once in a workflow commit receipt and absent from every idempotent channel; session-scoped validation rejecting stale/foreign/consumed bindings) produces a non-degenerate bank certifiable pre-freeze: under the frozen benchmark conventions (B-COLD-RE-DERIVE = re-derive session state per task with context discard; B-RETRIEVAL-SHAPED = identical requests plus local retrieval_calls over the frozen prior-session store), each of the two families (F1-RECORDS, F2-WIDGETS) yields predicted success_rate 0.875 (140/160) at novelty 0.50 and 0.75 (window [0.80, 0.95)), 1.0 below novelty 0.5, with T-AMORTIZED-DISCOVERY and PC-EXACT-REPLAY at 1.0 - delivering a bank with real treatment/comparator distinction and honest counters.
falsifier: F-CEILING: any family shows B-COLD-RE-DERIVE and/or B-RETRIEVAL-SHAPED success_rate >= 0.95 at novelty >= 0.5 (0.95 is the ceiling bound), or any arm's matched correctness < 0.80 at any novelty band, OR no family certifies (both families fail gates) -> the SESSION-BINDING class is declared degenerate -> bounded substrate-class negative (freeze nothing / record bounded negative at EXECUTE). F-LEAK: the one-time binding (or any value sufficient to reconstruct it) is present in any idempotent channel (/session, /task/{i}, non-receipt commit responses, error bodies) -> NC-NO-LEAK fires -> class property violated -> MIXED/negative. F-FLOOR: any non-chain cell deviates from its frozen expected outcome vector (expected-vs-measured equality gate) -> MEASUREMENT_INVALID, not a negative result. F-RECOMPUTE: double-run divergence or counter-trace re-derivation mismatch -> MEASUREMENT_INVALID.

construction.substrate_class: SESSION-BINDING: credential-free deterministic stdlib localhost HTTP (http.server / urllib only), single in-process server, no persistence, no external network, no credentials, no LLM calls.
construction.session: K=8 tasks per session; session created via GET /api/v1/{family}/session -> {session_token, schema, epoch}; session_token is opaque (SHA-256 of server secret + family + novelty + session_index), NOT the binding seed.
construction.binding: one-time session-scoped value: 48 bits, derived as SHA-256(server_secret, family, novelty, session_index, 'binding') truncated to 48 bits; revealed EXACTLY ONCE in the commit receipt of the precursor task (band 0.50: precursor task index 4, chain task index 5, carry distance 1; band 0.75: precursor task index 5, chain task index 7, carry distance 2); absent from all idempotent channels (NC-NO-LEAK); rejected by server when stale/foreign/consumed (400 invalid) so re-derivation within the 128-request/session budget would need ~2^47 guesses.

protocol.GET /api/v1/{family}/session: create/look up session -> {session_token, schema, epoch}; NEVER contains the binding (except NC-MECHANISM-OFF symmetric configuration, where it does)
protocol.POST /api/v1/{family}/commit: {session_token, task_index, resource_id, payload} -> 200 {receipt} on success, 400 invalid/missing binding, 409 already-committed (idempotency; re-commit of precursor NEVER re-reveals the binding)

novelty_semantics.0.00: schema_required=false; resource_id explicit in task spec; no chain task -> no discovery needed; all arms 1.0
novelty_semantics.0.25: schema_required=true (wire schema discovered via /session); resource_id explicit; no chain task -> all arms 1.0
novelty_semantics.0.50: schema_required=true + exactly one chain task (index 5; binding revealed in task-4 commit receipt, carry distance 1)
novelty_semantics.0.75: schema_required=true + exactly one chain task (index 7; binding revealed in task-5 commit receipt, carry distance 2)

construction.novelty_fraction: novelty = fraction of commit parameters whose correct value is not determined by (task spec union frozen grammar): 0.00 -> 0/4; 0.25 -> 1/4 (wire schema); 0.50 -> 2/4 for chain task (wire schema + session-scoped binding), 1/4 for others; 0.75 -> 3/4 for chain task (schema + binding + binding placement requiring >1-step context retention), 1/4 for others. Band label fixed by construction; certificate gates evaluated at novelty >= 0.5 (bands 0.50 and 0.75).
construction.sample: N_SESSIONS=20 per (family x novelty x arm) cell -> 160 scored tasks per cell; full scored matrix: 2 families x 4 novelties x 4 scored arms (T, B-COLD-RE-DERIVE, B-RETRIEVAL-SHAPED, PC-EXACT-REPLAY) x 20 sessions = 640 scored sessions; plus controls below.
construction.determinism: single run_seed fixed at EXECUTE; per-(family,novelty,session_index) seeds via SHA-256 of (seed, family, novelty, session_index); no process hash(); no wall-clock dependence in outcomes (latency advisory only); full double-run with identical seed must reproduce every per-task outcome and counter byte-identically (NC-DOUBLE-RUN).
construction.arm_scope: arms interact ONLY through the HTTP surface defined above; any access to server-process state, bank files or generator internals is a protocol violation (frozen prohibition). EXECUTE may not import research/runtime/* or any repo module into the measurement path (stdlib-only prohibition).

arms.T-AMORTIZED-DISCOVERY: treatment (inheritor stand-in): GET /session once per session; retains context including the precursor commit receipt; captures next_resource_id (binding) from the receipt; commits chain task with the captured binding; commit once per task. Predicted: success 1.0; http=17; retrieval_calls=0; verification_calls=8; repair_attempts=0 per session.
arms.B-COLD-RE-DERIVE: mandated comparator: before EVERY task, GET /session and DISCARD prior task context (no receipt retention); at the chain task the binding is not re-derivable (one-time, 48-bit, non-leaked) -> first commit 400, one repair re-attempt also 400 -> chain task failed. Predicted: success 0.875 (7/8) at novelty >= 0.5, 1.0 below; http=25; retrieval_calls=0; verification_calls=9; repair_attempts=1 per session.
arms.B-RETRIEVAL-SHAPED: mandated comparator: identical request pattern to cold PLUS one local retrieval_calls per task over the frozen prior-session store (8/session); for the chain task it retrieves the binding value recorded in a DIFFERENT session (stale within this session's registry) -> server 400 -> fail. Predicted: success 0.875 at novelty >= 0.5, 1.0 below; http=25; retrieval_calls=8; verification_calls=9; repair_attempts=1 per session.
arms.PC-EXACT-REPLAY: positive control: golden-input oracle executor given the session's exact binding and schema by frozen construction (no HTTP discovery); proves the substrate is completable and scoring is not degenerate. Predicted: success 1.0; http=17; retrieval_calls=0; verification_calls=8; repair_attempts=0 per session.

baselines.role: mandated cold re-derivation comparator; defines the 0.95 ceiling gate (< 0.95 at novelty >= 0.5)
mandated retrieval-shaped comparator; defines the 0.95 ceiling gate (< 0.95 at novelty >= 0.5)
degenerate ceiling baseline from the excluded class (REST: COLD=RETRIEVAL=1.0); used as the discriminability reference and as the NC-MECHANISM-OFF expected outcome
baselines.expected: 1.0 on the excluded REST class (do NOT re-run); 1.0 on NC-MECHANISM-OFF configuration -> certificate FALSE

positive_control.role: proves the substrate is completable and the scorer is not degenerate; also liveness anchor for T (T must equal PC at 1.0; a broken T capture would drop T to 0.875 and trip the behavioral-distinction gate)
positive_control.expected: success 1.0 at all novelty bands in both families; counters http=17, retrieval_calls=0, verification_calls=8, repair_attempts=0 per session

null_control.role: mechanism ablation: the ONE-TIME-ness of the binding is disabled (binding also present in /session, i.e., symmetric re-derivable discovery) with the identical task bank and arm policies
null_control.expected: B-COLD-RE-DERIVE and B-RETRIEVAL-SHAPED both reach 1.0 at novelty >= 0.5 -> certificate check returns FALSE -> proves (a) the certificate procedure can fire negative (non-vacuous, negative branch inhabited at measure time) and (b) the one-time asymmetric mechanism, not the bank content or arm definitions alone, produces the dynamic range

controls.NC-EMPTIED-CONTEXT: T-AMORTIZED-DISCOVERY minus context retention (captures receipt, discards it before the chain task). Expected 0.875 at novelty >= 0.5, 1.0 below. Isolates retention as the operative distinction between T and the comparators.
controls.NC-SHUFFLED-BINDING: T with a binding valid in ANOTHER session of the same family; server rejects (400). Expected 0.875 at novelty >= 0.5. Proves session-scoping is server-enforced.
controls.NC-FAMILY-ISOLATION: T with a binding drawn from the OTHER family; server rejects. Expected 0.875 at novelty >= 0.5. Proves family isolation.
controls.NC-NO-DISCOVERY-DIRECT: spec-only actor: uses only task specs, no /session, no schema, no receipts. Expected 1.0 at novelty 0.00 (schema_required=false), 0.0 at novelty >= 0.25 (schema required). Proves correct action is NOT determined by spec alone and discovery is genuinely required.
controls.NC-NO-LEAK: mechanical scan of EVERY idempotent response body (/session, /task/{i}, non-receipt commit responses, all 400/409 error bodies) for the binding value and for any value sufficient to reconstruct it (receipt is the sole permitted occurrence, exactly once); plus recompute of binding entropy (48 bits >= 40-bit floor). A single hit -> F-LEAK.
controls.NC-EQUAL-BUDGET: every arm operates under the same 128-request/session ceiling (max predicted usage 25); no arm is starved; budget never binds (proves failure is not budget-induced).
controls.NC-NO-SYNTHETIC: server returns no hints/assistive values (no Levenshtein feedback, no partial credit); scoring is exact-match of final committed state against the deterministic ground-truth manifest.
controls.NC-ARM-BLIND-SCORING: scorer is a pure stateless function over (task_index, final_committed_state) rows only; the scorer never sees arm identity, arm traces, retrieval store contents or counters. Verified by frozen interface contract.
controls.NC-COUNTER-INTEGRITY: all four counters are re-derived from a single interleaved execution trace with monotonic request ids. Frozen invariants: http_requests == session_creates + task_reads + commit_requests; verification_calls == commit_requests; repair_attempts <= verification_calls; retrieval_calls == 0 for all arms except B-RETRIEVAL-SHAPED; re-derivation must match exactly.
controls.NC-DOUBLE-RUN: full scored matrix executed twice with the same run_seed; every per-task outcome and counter must be byte-identical; any divergence -> MEASUREMENT_INVALID.

counters.http_requests: count of every HTTP request issued by the arm (success, failure, repair re-attempts), from the single trace
counters.retrieval_calls: count of local retrieval invocations over the frozen prior-session store (B-RETRIEVAL-SHAPED only)
counters.verification_calls: count of commit requests = count of ground-truth checks performed (includes repair re-attempts: cold/retrieval 9, others 8)
counters.repair_attempts: count of commit requests issued after an initial failure for the same task (cold/retrieval 1/session at novelty >= 0.5; 0 otherwise)

pre_freeze_arithmetic_certificate.novelty_monotonicity: NOT preregistered and NOT gated: identical 0.875 at bands 0.50 and 0.75 is expected by construction (same one-time-binding failure mechanism at both carry distances).

contamination_controls.cache_vs_test_ids: T's retained context contains only {session schema, explicit resource ids from specs, the current session's receipt}; B-RETRIEVAL-SHAPED's store contains ONLY values from sessions OTHER than the current one (frozen prior-session store); no arm ever receives the current session's binding except through the single server-issued receipt (T/PC).
contamination_controls.server_enforced: server validates every resource_id against the live session registry and consumes the binding on first use; stale/foreign/consumed values -> 400 (verified by NC-SHUFFLED-BINDING, NC-FAMILY-ISOLATION, NC-NO-LEAK).
contamination_controls.matched_manifests: identical task manifests per (family, novelty) across all arms; arms differ ONLY in frozen policy, never in stimuli.
contamination_controls.cache_only_oracle: a cache-only oracle (retrieval store only, no /session, no spec discovery) completes 0 tasks at novelty >= 0.25 (NC-NO-DISCOVERY-DIRECT is its behavioral proxy: spec-only actor) - no test-session answer is obtainable from stores.
contamination_controls.arm_blind_scoring: scorer sees only (task_index, final_committed_state) rows; no arm identity, traces, stores or counters.
